purpose: Freeze the independent population, object split, duplicate handling, primary decision, missing-data policy, and authorization boundary before any independent thermodynamic target is selected or opened.

source_eligibility.population: Massive galaxy clusters selected without using the Item 59 response or residual, with released direct gas-density, stellar-baryon, SZ-pressure, and X-ray-temperature inputs sufficient for the frozen forward model.
primary_lane_requirements: different survey or reduction-family identity from X-COP
public object inventory and documented selection function
calibration, background, PSF-or-beam, mask, response, and covariance roles
per-file release revision, license, checksum, and object identifier
secondary_lane_requirements: different instrument or reduction family from the selected primary lane
at least one direct thermodynamic target and the corresponding predictor packet
file-level release revision, license, checksum, calibration roles, and covariance
completed X-COP and primary-lane duplicate audit
source_eligibility.source_selection_rule: Choose the eligible primary lane with the largest number of whole clusters meeting every primary requirement; break a tie by the lexicographically smallest lane_id. Choose the eligible secondary lane from a different reduction family by the same rule. If no lane qualifies, select neither.

population_and_quality_freeze.mass_proxy_use: A source-published selection mass proxy may define the population but may not enter the candidate formula, scoring, exclusion, or object-specific coefficients.
quality_rules: keep disturbed, merging, cool-core, and non-cool-core systems if the packet passes instrument quality requirements
require finite positive radii, predictors, targets, and declared uncertainties
require at least one measured outer pressure point reserved only as the unscored boundary anchor
do not exclude an object because the candidate or a comparator predicts it poorly
preserve every failed object in a machine-readable data-quality ledger

xcop_exclusion_freeze.action: Exclude any independent-source object resolved to one of these identities from primary or secondary replication scoring and record the match evidence before target access.

canonicalization_order: normalized SIMBAD-style canonical name when supplied in public metadata
casefolded alias with punctuation and whitespace removed
identity_and_duplicate_freeze.cross_source_duplicate_action: Assign one canonical identity and one split; retain the predeclared primary-lane packet for primary scoring and use other packets only for explicitly secondary cross-instrument checks.

predictor_blind_split_freeze.algorithm: Compute sha256(salt + ':' + canonical_object_id), sort ascending, assign the first min(24,floor(N/5)) eligible identities to infrastructure_development and every remaining identity to untouched_confirmation.
predictor_blind_split_freeze.infrastructure_development_use: May validate parsing, units, covariance, and preregistered nuisance implementation; may not change the candidate, primary endpoint, success thresholds, exclusion rules, or confirmation split.
predictor_blind_split_freeze.confirmation_access: One authorized opening after every pre-data gate passes.

primary_decision_freeze.score: Covariance-aware squared log predictive error, averaged first within each observable and cluster, then equally over pressure and temperature and equally over clusters; lower is better.
primary_decision_freeze.catastrophic_cluster_definition: Either observable has a cluster-level median absolute log residual greater than ln(1.5), or the forward evaluator emits a nonfinite or nonpositive prediction at an eligible scored row.
primary_decision_freeze.per_observable_requirement: The candidate must beat every required comparator separately for pressure and temperature and meet both observable-specific absolute-accuracy limits.
primary_decision_freeze.influence_requirement: The aggregate advantage over every required comparator must remain positive in every leave-one-cluster-out fold, after symmetric 5-percent influence trimming, and in at least 80 percent of frozen radial, mass, redshift, morphology, and instrument strata containing five or more clusters.
primary_decision_freeze.multiplicity: The joint endpoint is primary. Pressure, temperature, radial, population, and secondary-lane endpoints are secondary and use Holm control at familywise alpha 0.05.
primary_decision_freeze.posterior_edge_rule: A required nuisance posterior with more than 10 percent of probability in the outer 5 percent of a frozen prior range blocks a positive physical interpretation and is reported for the bounded empirical result.
primary_decision_freeze.no_repair_rule: No candidate, coefficient, threshold, split, exclusion, comparator, nuisance prior, or endpoint may change after confirmation access. Any change creates a named descendant requiring a different untouched external sample.

sample_size_and_stopping_freeze.classification_rule: At least 192 untouched confirmation clusters permits the preregistered confirmatory decision. Between 120 and 191 is explicitly underpowered exploratory replication and cannot be labeled a confirmatory pass. Fewer than 120 does not open as the primary trial.
sample_size_and_stopping_freeze.stopping_rule: Open the frozen confirmation once and analyze every eligible object. Do not stop early for success, failure, cost, or a desired narrative.

pre_access_exclusions: resolved duplicate retained in another primary packet
missing required predictor or both required primary targets
missing declared uncertainty or covariance role
fewer than five eligible radial bins for either primary observable
payload checksum, release, license, calibration, or provenance failure
ambiguous object identity not resolved from public metadata
missing_data_and_exclusion_freeze.partial_observable_rule: A primary-lane object missing either pressure or temperature is not in the joint primary cohort; it remains in the ledger and may enter only a frozen secondary single-observable analysis.
missing_data_and_exclusion_freeze.missing_radial_rows: Score available preregistered bins without interpolation across an unmeasured gap. Missingness stress tests remain secondary and may not delete inconvenient rows.
missing_data_and_exclusion_freeze.censoring: Use a released likelihood or one-sided limit when available; otherwise preserve the row as unscored missing data with its declared reason.
missing_data_and_exclusion_freeze.extrapolation: Do not score outside both the released measurement support and 0.1 to 2.0 R500.
missing_data_and_exclusion_freeze.catastrophic_predictions: Count nonfinite or nonpositive predictions as catastrophic failures; never silently clip them into the scoring range.

target_manifest_may_expose_before_author: file path or opaque object key
